steps.summary: The type now runs on a short ladder of six sizes and three weights, so headings stand out by size and the page stops shouting in capitals.

changes.what: The page title is smaller and set in the heading weight, within the product ceiling of 1.6 × body
Fewer font weights, each with one job: regular, lifted, heading
Fewer font sizes, every one tied to a role
Uppercase eyebrows over the sidebar and the notifications table are now sentence case
Button labels step down to the interface size and the lifted weight
Section descriptions move up a text tier, so they read as supporting copy rather than fine print
Sidebar icons match the size of the 13px labels beside them
Form fields use 16px text on phones, so iOS doesn't zoom in when you tap one

steps.summary: Every colour is now a named token that passes its contrast check in both themes, and the sidebar marks your current section with the brand blue.

changes.what: Input borders, secondary buttons and the off toggle are dark enough to see as controls
Primary buttons in dark mode get a deeper blue so their white text passes
The orange "Unsaved changes" status is dark enough to read
The current section in the sidebar sits on a blue tint with a blue label, instead of a white raised chip
changes.before: white chip, shadow and border; #101828 label

changes.what: The quietest grey text is darkened to clear its target on hovered rows
Passed password rules show an ink check on a grey circle instead of a green tick
changes.after: ink check on a neutral circle

changes.what: Colours typed straight into the CSS all become named tokens

steps.summary: The five boxed sections are now one calm column on the page, separated by their headings and space, with the one table framed as a table.

changes.what: Settings sections sit on the page instead of each in its own white card
changes.after: 0 — sections stacked, each opened by its heading

changes.what: The grey footer strips behind each save button are gone
changes.after: an action row 20px under the fields

changes.what: With the cards gone, the page itself is the white the cards were
Notification settings take the one product table style: a hairline frame and a tinted header row
changes.before: rows inside a card, no frame

changes.what: More space between sections than inside them, so each heading clearly belongs to what follows
Structural lines are thinner
Content starts closer under the top bar
Hover styles only apply on devices with a real pointer
Rounded corners drawn as squircles, so cards, fields and buttons read soft rather than boxy
changes.after: superellipse(1.5) corners at the same 8/12px radii; pills and circles stay round

steps.summary: Everything in the page now sits flat on it, and only the dialog and the toast float, each with one consistent shadow.

changes.what: The top bar is solid instead of frosted glass
Buttons lose their drop shadows
Form fields lose their faint shadow: their edge does the work
The delete dialog drops its one-off red icon circle; the danger stays on the delete button
The dialog backdrop dims without blurring the page
In dark mode the dialog lifts by getting lighter, not just by its shadow
The dialog shadow is one light: an edge ring, a contact layer and one soft ambient layer

steps.summary: Animations now share one short set of durations and one curve, respond instantly when pressed, and each has its own gentler version for reduced motion.

changes.what: Durations come from one ladder, sized by how much of the screen changes
One easing curve for movement, one for colour, one for exits
Toggles snap over faster on the shared curve
Pressing a button shows a pressed surface at once instead of nudging it down
The toast leaves faster than it arrives
Notification rows fade their hover wash instead of snapping
changes.law: motion dials (hover on a large surface)

changes.what: Reduced motion gets a real alternative per component, not a global off switch
changes.before: every transition and animation forced to 0.01ms
changes.after: dialog fades, toast fades in place, spinner stops; 3 component branches

steps.summary: Feedback now appears where it belongs: saves confirm beside their button, a reversible disconnect offers Undo, and deleting the account says exactly what is lost.

changes.what: Saving no longer pops a toast on top of the status line that already says it saved
Disconnecting a service can be undone from the toast
Deleting the account shows progress and keeps the dialog open until it's done
The delete dialog says what will be lost
changes.after: names profile, personal tasks, comments and where owned projects go

changes.what: A password that misses a rule shows it on the rule, instead of adding another line under the field
changes.after: 0 extra lines; unmet rules turn red, 6.57:1

changes.what: The ⌘K hint in the search box now works
The password form's error says what to do
changes.after: "Fix the highlighted fields to update your password."

changes.what: Settling: the focus ring inside the toast gets its own colour so it shows on the toast's inverted surface
changes.before: page focus colour, 2.44:1 on the dark-mode toast
